name: How should homeowners prepare their living space before interior remodeling starts?

mainEntity.name: How should homeowners prepare their living space before interior remodeling starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your contractor begins, clear personal belongings, wall decor, and furniture out of the work zone to protect items and allow clear crew access. Designate a staging area for materials, decide on your daily household routine, and confirm finish selections such as paint sheens, trim profiles, and tile patterns. If your project includes kitchen or bathroom downtime, setting up temporary living accommodations or alternate wash spaces prevents daily disruption while drywall, framing, and tile work take place.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear furniture and valuables from the workspace, finalize your tile and trim choices, and set up a temporary living area for daily routines during construction.
